prompts.master:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production RGBA key-pose sprite sheet for the Demian cafe arcade game.
Input images: Image 1 is Tiam's identity, hair, glasses and clothing reference. Image 2 (Setayesh) and Image 3 (Darya) are STYLE references only: reproduce their charming detailed pixel-art/chibi game aesthetic, NOT their faces, hair or clothes.
Primary request: create TIAM, a young adult woman based closely on the woman in Image 1. Shoulder-length center-parted softly wavy nearly black hair, black rectangular eyeglasses, warm light olive skin, dark eyes, dark burgundy lips, friendly confident expression. Oversized very dark navy DEMIAN T-shirt, loose magenta/pink and black plaid wide-leg trousers, cream canvas sneakers. A tiny cute warm brown cockroach called Homayoun with two expressive eyes, six small legs and two antennae sits on her shoulder in EVERY pose, including back views. It is a cute companion, about one quarter of the head width. Keep glasses clearly visible whenever her face is visible, and the plaid clothing fully consistent throughout.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no poster, no titles, no labels, no grid lines.
Composition/framing: a square 2048x2048 clean technical sprite sheet, exactly EIGHT equally spaced columns by SEVEN equally spaced rows. Exactly 56 isolated full-body figures, one centered in each cell, generous transparent gutters. No cropping and no overlapping neighboring figures. All same body proportions, about 2.8 heads tall like the Darya/Setayesh style. Camera fixed orthographic.
Rows from top to bottom:
1: eight distinct standing direction views in this precise order: front/south, front-left/southwest, left/west, back-left/northwest, back/north, back-right/northeast, right/east, front-right/southeast.
2: eight sequential idle/breath/blink cycle poses, all facing right/east in three-quarter view, relaxed arms, subtly varied breathing and blink.
3: eight sequential WALK cycle keyframes, all facing right/east, alternating legs, opposite arm swings, both left and right strides included.
4: eight sequential JUMP keyframes, all facing right/east: anticipate, low bend, push-off, rising tucked legs, apex tucked knees, descending legs, ready for contact, recovered standing. Foot baseline approximately consistent because game physics owns jump height.
5: eight sequential LOW CROUCH poses, all facing right/east, real knee/hip bends, maintaining same head size.
6: eight sequential LAND recovery poses, all facing right/east: standing contact, deep knee bend, compression, spring-back, recovery, straighten, settle, stand.
7: eight sequential happy celebration/wave poses, all facing right/east, including wave up, wave left/right, peace sign and greeting Homayoun. Cockroach stays perched on shoulder.
Style/medium: detailed handcrafted-looking pixel illustration, dark clean outline, crisp pixels, restricted coherent palette, warm highlights, charming game sprite quality matching the two illustrated reference sheets. Consistent identity across ALL 56 frames.
Constraints: PNG with genuine transparent alpha. Only the tiny word DEMIAN on visible shirt fronts, no other text. No cat, no wings, no curly auburn hair, no weapons, no hats. Homayoun present on every shoulder. Full figure visible in every cell, including sneakers. Do not create a character poster. This must be an animation SOURCE SHEET with 56 different poses, not repeated standstill images.
prompts.shoulderCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: exact correction to the provided production character sprite sheet.
Edit target: the supplied TIAM image. Preserve the existing 8-column x 6-row sprite sheet, all 48 poses, all cells, scale, pixel style, faces, eyeglasses, hairstyles, plaid trousers, shirts, sneakers, silhouettes, spacing and genuine transparency.
Change ONLY Homayoun's position in the BOTTOM celebration row where the cute cockroach is held in a raised hand (especially column 4 and column 7). Remove the hand-held cockroach and ensure ONE identical small cute orange-brown six-legged two-antenna cockroach is resting securely ON TIAM'S SHOULDER near the shirt collar in each corrected frame. Keep all hand gestures themselves. Homayoun is a shoulder companion, never a carried object. Do not add a second bug. Other 46 or already-correct frames should remain unchanged.
Keep the transparent alpha. No new captions, no decoration, no added grid, no crop, no resize, no new row or column. Output the SAME technical sprite sheet with the shoulder positioning corrected.
prompts.runnerAndLanding:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RGBA animation SOURCE SHEET for Demian TIAM.
Input images: Image 1 is the APPROVED generated Tiam master sheet and is the strict character identity/style reference. Image 2 is her original identity/clothing photo, supporting reference only.
Primary request: Create a new animation sheet of exactly the SAME woman character: softly wavy center-parted shoulder-length nearly black hair, black rectangular glasses, navy DEMIAN oversized T-shirt, pink/magenta-black plaid wide-leg trousers, cream sneakers. Same face, same head/body scale and proportions, crisp detailed pixel illustration. Tiny cute orange-brown cockroach Homayoun (six small legs, two antennae, expressive eyes) securely perched ON THE SHOULDER in EVERY frame, never on a hand, never missing.
Backdrop: transparent alpha, no floor or cast shadows, no text captions, no decorations.
Composition: wide 1536x1024 sheet with exactly EIGHT columns and THREE rows: 24 separate full-body figures with generous transparent spacing. Every cell equal width and height; same character scale throughout, complete shoes visible. All characters facing RIGHT/east in the same three-quarter view, NOT frontal.
Rows 1 and 2 together form ONE 16-keyframe running cycle: forward lean, alternating opposite arm/leg motion, strong clearly distinct leg extensions and tucked recovery, toe-off, flight, opposite-foot landing, recovery, full symmetric left/right strides. Rightward locomotion, compact enough poses for a square runtime frame, no weapons or particles.
Row 3 is exactly EIGHT consecutive LANDING RECOVERY keyframes: first contact upright with feet down, knee flex, deep knee/hip compression, deepest crouch, rise halfway, straighten, relaxed settling, upright recovered stance. Keep head, glasses, shoulder companion and shoes the same size during crouch. All frame soles on a consistent baseline; no airborne scene displacement (game physics controls height).
Constraints: exactly 24 real distinct full-body poses arranged in the 8 by 3 grid, maintaining the master identity. Homayoun must remain clearly attached to shoulder in every pose. Transparent background. No names/headings/grids, no hand-held bug, no cat, no wings, no glow, no dust. Detailed chibi pixel art matching Image 1 exactly.
prompts.lowSlide:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RGBA low-slide animation SOURCE SHEET for TIAM in the Demian arcade game.
Input image 1: approved TIAM master, strict identity and detailed pixel-art style reference. Input image 2: original reference photo for glasses/hair/clothing only.
Primary request: eight sequential LOW SLIDING poses for exactly the SAME woman: wavy center-parted black shoulder-length hair, black rectangular glasses, friendly light olive face, oversized navy DEMIAN shirt, pink/magenta-and-black plaid wide-leg trousers, cream canvas sneakers. Homayoun is a tiny cute orange-brown cockroach with expressive eyes, six small legs, two antennae, perched on her shoulder near the collar in EVERY frame.
Composition: exactly FOUR equally spaced columns and TWO equally spaced rows (8 full-body sprites). Landscape 1536x1024, generous transparent gutters, no grid lines or titles. Same head size and uniform body scale in all frames. All face RIGHT/east in three-quarter/profile view. The 8 frames in row-major order are one looping seated/low-knee skid/slide: very low hips, one leg extended forward toward the right, the other bent under the body, slight backward torso lean, hands close to torso, slight consecutive variation of legs, hair and shoulders. Both rows MUST be low sliding, not upright running and not standing crouch.
Every pose's TOP-OF-HEAD to FOOT height must be at most 60 percent of this character's standing height when the head remains same size. Preserve the full-size head and glasses; achieve short height by genuine deep hip/knee bend and seated leg extension. Homayoun stays safely on her shoulder, no flying away. Complete shoes visible, no motion streaks or ground shadows.
Style: crisp clean dark pixel outlines, detailed chibi pixel illustration matching the master. Genuine transparent background alpha. No text except tiny DEMIAN on visible shirt fronts. No labels, no cat, no wings, no dust, no hearts. Exactly 8 isolated different slide keyframes with no overlap between cells.
